There's been nothing but bad news
lately, but there was good news too.

rows.label: tlk41200141_05_msg0002

They said Lilio and the
others are in Avaritia!

rows.label: tlk41200141_05_msg0003

Dad said he'll take me there once
things in Alst settle down...

rows.label: tlk41200141_05_msg0004

I never thought I'd get to see my
friends from Iraada Village again,
so I'm really looking forward to it.
